title: Silence optional profile lookup and harden shell and profile identity fallback
goal: Treat a missing optional user profile extension as a normal result and prevent broken avatars or duplicate identity labels from repeating the shell or ProfileCenter hero identity.

in: Query optional system_user_profile_ext rows without record-not-found logging while preserving real database errors and JSON parsing semantics
Fallback from a failed avatar image to the uppercase first character of the display name in the shell and ProfileCenter hero
Hide a username or role label when it equals the display name after trimming and case folding
Add focused backend and frontend regression tests
out: No API, schema, permission, menu, route, i18n, CSS, dependency, or pantheon-ops changes
No git commit or external environment action

assumptionsAndOpenQuestions: The existing GORM Find behavior is the repository-compatible way to query an optional single row without emitting ErrRecordNotFound.
A shared identity helper and avatar content component is the smallest testable frontend change without coupling ProfileCenter to layout internals.
minimumViableApproach: Reuse GORM Find and React state; move identity presentation primitives to shared data-display components and consume them from the shell and ProfileCenter.
successCriteria: loadUserProfileExt returns nil, nil when the extension table exists but the user has no extension row.
A genuine profile extension query error is returned unchanged.
A broken avatar image is removed and replaced by the uppercase display-name initial, and the same URL can be retried after changing away and back.
A username or role label equal to the display name after trim and case-insensitive comparison is not rendered in the shell or ProfileCenter hero.
ProfileCenter does not render repeated admin labels for nickname, username, and roles all equal to admin; distinct username and roles remain visible.

affectedSubgraph: UserService.loadUserProfileExt -> GORM optional row query -> JSON decode
Shell and ProfileCenter userInfo -> shared avatar and identity presentation
boundaryCrossings: platform shell consumes current system/iam user identity
riskNodes: shared identity rendering in shell and ProfileCenter
graphFocus: No new dependency direction, cycle, hub, or deeper call chain

browser: Explicit visual/runtime gap if no authenticated browser runtime is available
